## Outcome

Describe the behavior or evidence this delivery adds.

## Prerequisites

Link the required issues and identify any blocker.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Define the behavior and a check that would fail without it.
- [ ] Record the tested revision, results and verification limits.

## Tracking

Select the actual milestone and area label. Add this issue and its delivery PR
to [Project #6](https://github.com/users/gokselozgur5/projects/6).

Use atomic commits. Keep partial work open; close only after acceptance and
integration. See [the delivery workflow](https://github.com/gokselozgur5/orbital-mechanic/blob/main/docs/DELIVERY.md).
